name: Ca chinh song Son
summary: Son River eel is named by the Quang Binh visitor portal on 29 May 2024 and again on 13 June 2025. Grilled is the plate the May article singles out. The June article also lists braised, kho, and steamed.
origin: The Son at Phong Nha, in the Quang Binh visitor portal’s articles of 29 May 2024 and 13 June 2025.
texture: The 13 June 2025 article says the flesh is firm and naturally sweet.
taste: The 29 May 2024 article describes grilled eel as rich and lightly spicy.
howToEat: The 29 May 2024 article singles out grilled eel.
The 13 June 2025 article also lists braised, kho, and steamed.
A door, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: The Son at Phong Nha. A shop address is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca chinh song Son — eel from the Son
seoDescription: Son River eel is grilled in the 29 May 2024 account, and also braised, kho, or steamed in the 13 June 2025 account. A price is Check on arrival.
